title: Answer
description:
The true tent is not of this creation. The tent in the wilderness was the copy that belongs to this creation.

The blood of bulls and goats, offered first for the priest himself, did what that day required. It never took sins away for good.

The ashes that purified the unclean purified the flesh. They could not purge the conscience.

The victim had to be without spot, and the life is in the blood. Christ offered Himself to God, without spot, through the eternal Spirit. He is both Priest and victim.
